newsitem.title: USA: PP&L sees Susquehanna 1 Pa. nuke back Wed.
newsitem.headline: PP&L sees Susquehanna 1 Pa. nuke back Wed.

text.p: Pennsylvania Power & Light Co (PP&L) said Wednesday it aimed to bring the 1,090 megawatt (MW) Susquehanna 1 nuclear power unit on line later today.
"We hope late this afternoon to be synchronized to the grid," an onsite spokeswoman said.
The Berwick, Pa., unit is in the process of returning to operation following a refueling and maintenance outage that began September 7.
The adjoining Susquehanna 2 was producing at 100 percent of 1,094 MW capacity, she said.
The two Susquehanna units are jointly owned by PP&L and Allegheny Electric Cooperative Inc.
The Susquehanna facility accounts for 30 percent of PP&L power deliveries and 20 percent of its installed generation capacity.
